feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
entry.summary: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.

entry.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
entry.summary: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".

entry.title: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers after the QB rips coach Mike McCarthy on TV
entry.summary: The move capped a chaotic 18 hours in which the team announced it was benching the 42-year-old future Hall of Famer for backup Mason Rudolph ahead of Friday's visit from Denver.

entry.title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
entry.summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

entry.title: At this Little Free Bakery in Austin, neighbors come for the pastries and stay for community connection
entry.summary: The bakers behind these pop-up pastry drops aren't raking in the profits, but they are building a space for people to come together in polarized times.

entry.title: Group of Senate Democrats push to add freshman to leadership
entry.summary: Several Democratic senators have been signaling this move, saying the party needs to acknowledge the diverse class of incoming freshman that catapulted the party to victory in November.

entry.title: How American Thanksgiving took root -- and evolved -- in Liberia
entry.summary: The first settlers of Liberia were African Americans who brought along the holiday of Thanksgiving — which has evolved to reflect the history and identity of this new nation.

entry.title: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping
entry.summary: 59% of U.S. shoppers plan to use AI for holiday shopping this weekend, according to the National Retail Federation

entry.title: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.
entry.summary: Authorities have evacuated a 5-mile radius to prepare to dispose of thousands of pounds of lead azide. And, after a nearly two-year legal battle, Kilmar Abrego Garcia's has voluntarily left the U.S.

entry.title: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
entry.summary: "The public is rightly concerned," says the Republican lawmaker, who wants to know what the FBI and CIA knew about potential national security threats and whether Jensen Huang was warned.
